learning_objective: 🎯 Learn how to show your happy, calm, or excited feelings on paper using beautiful colors and magical shapes!

main_concepts.simple_explanation: Did you know colors can show how you feel? Yellow makes us think of happy sunshine, while soft blue can make us feel calm and sleepy.
Abstract art means you do not have to draw a perfect tree or house. You can just swirl colors, dots, and lines to show what your heart is feeling!
Sometimes when we have too many thoughts, drawing slowly and quietly helps our minds relax and feel peaceful.

fun_activity.title: 🎨 The Feelings Color Wheel!
fun_activity.instructions: Draw two big circles. In the first circle, use colors and zig-zags to show how excitement feels. In the second circle, use soft colors and gentle waves to show calmness.

quick_recap: ⭐ We can use bright or soft colors to share our feelings without using words.
⭐ Abstract art uses simple lines and shapes instead of real objects.
⭐ Drawing is a wonderful way to relax and calm our busy minds.
